name: Dev Tool for ACF
author: Sandeep Gupta

sections.description:
The Dev Tool for ACF extends Functionality ACF, including ACF Pro, enabling dynamic field visibility control based on user roles or registered email addresses.

Key features:
* Display custom fields conditionally for specific user roles.
* Restrict field visibility based on user email addresses.
* Seamless integration with Advanced Custom Fields.
* Simplified setup and intuitive controls for visibility rules.

This tool is perfect for developers who want finer control over custom field visibility in WordPress.
sections.installation:
Automated Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to the “Plugins” menu and click “Add New”.
  3. Search for “Dev Tool for ACF”.
  4. Click “Install Now” and activate the plugin.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the Dev Tool for ACF plugin and extract the ZIP file.
  2. Upload the extracted folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory on your WordPress server.
  3. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” menu in your WordPress admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
How does the plugin control field visibility?

The plugin uses Advanced Custom Fields’ hooks and logic to apply rules based on user roles or email addresses.

Can I use this plugin with any version of ACF?

This plugin is compatible with ACF version 5.0 and later.

Will this plugin work with both ACF and ACF Pro?

Yes, this plugin is compatible with both ACF (free version) and ACF Pro, starting from version 5.0 and later.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

No, the plugin provides an easy-to-use interface for setting up visibility rules.
